title: EIA Weekly Petroleum Stocks WPSR
description: Weekly Petroleum Status Report - commercial crude, gasoline, and distillate stocks (US, Strategic Petroleum Reserve), Cushing OK crude, refinery utilisation, gasoline + distillate demand. Data updates Wednesdays at 10:30 ET. Each row reports latest value, prior-week change, 1-year-prior comparison, percentile vs 5-year range, and a regime flag (DRAW_HEAVY / DRAW / NEUTRAL / BUILD / BUILD_HEAVY for inventories; ELEVATED / TYPICAL / DEPRESSED for refining; STRONG / TYPICAL / WEAK for demand). Investment thesis maps to USO / BNO / XLE for oil exposure and UGA for gasoline. Free EIA v2 API requires EIA_API_KEY (free signup at api.eia.gov).
